reviews.review_text:
Zac Gray
New Zealand15 contributions
3
Masterclass in Hospitality and quality food!
Oct 2026 • Couples
After reading a few glowing reviews on this restaurant my wife and i decided to check it out. 
I am so glad we did!

My wife made a reservation last minute and we were able to get a seat on the rooftop balcony. What a stunning view!

We were warmly welcomed and seated by the most attentive and beautiful host Jimmy. His dedication to providing us with the warmest experience has not been matched in my 20 years of dining out throughout the world. The dishes he recommended us hit the spot perfectly. We had the grilled buffalo, the special pancakes and also the pork paste and lemongrass.

To top the experience off Jimmy told us exactly how they made their dipping sauce for the pancakes and even shifted our table to get the best view of the city, along with taking photos of my wife and i with the fantastic city skyline view in the background.

Pandan Leaf Saigon, 10/10 experience led by a masterclass in service and hospitality Jimmy. I even had to get a photo with this legend!
